digest_algorithms.grader: evallab.registry.compute_subpath_digest over tests/ (or verifier/); entire port source for port rows
digest_algorithms.static_plan: sha256 of canonical compact sorted-key JSON returned by run_candidate(plan=True)

pilot.rule: evenly spaced by sorted task_id: 6 of 36 mimo-defect-map-v1, 5 of 8 tb4-audit-v1; no cost or outcome criterion

price_basis.basis: resource/lifetime reservation estimates, not invoices or a provider dollar kill switch
price_basis.finalization_basis: only measured native success plus affirmative completed image hydration and terminal public SDK wait for every owned sandbox; both role builder and task resources charged for rounded-up whole-lifecycle elapsed
price_basis.preparation_lifetime_basis: full declared build_timeout_sec; provider builder timeout/cancellation is not claimed
price_basis.preparation_rate_basis: conservative Sandbox rates also used for the larger builder allowance; not assumed Functions pricing
price_basis.spend_scope: Modal infrastructure only; excludes task, solution and verifier external-API charges, which require separate caller authorization
